policy.green_rule: Prefer a verified permissive implementation whenever it satisfies the material capability, platform, accessibility, performance and product requirements.
policy.consent_rule: For copyleft, source-available, Commons-Clause-like, commercial, mixed or custom terms, do not materially adopt source until the exact current scope is verified and the user explicitly accepts the relevant obligation or restriction.
policy.unverified_rule: UNVERIFIED can inform discovery and research but cannot authorize direct adoption. Resolve canonical upstream license and exact artifact scope first.
policy.reference_only_rule: REFERENCE_ONLY may transfer independently synthesized mechanisms with provenance; do not copy source, assets, prose or trade dress.
policy.fallback_rule: If the user declines a restrictive source, automatically choose the strongest sufficiently capable GREEN alternative. If none exists, synthesize the mechanism independently and preserve the unmet requirement as an explicit limitation.
policy.restricted_override_rule: A restrictive source may outrank GREEN only for a materially unique requirement that GREEN candidates cannot satisfy. Cosmetic preference, popularity, stars, demo polish or convenience are insufficient reasons.
policy.aggregator_rule: Never inherit license claims from an awesome list, marketplace, registry or aggregator. Resolve the canonical upstream artifact and current terms.
policy.drift_rule: Re-check high/very-high drift sources and all material adoption candidates against primary upstream evidence immediately before use.
